/* ==========================================================================

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. CSS Custom Properties & Palette Themes
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
:root {
  /* Color Palette: Light & Neutral Harmonious Slate Scale */
  --bg-page: #f8fafc;            /* Clean light page background */
  --bg-surface: #ffffff;         /* Cards, modals, buttons */
  --bg-surface-subtle: #f1f5f9;  /* Secondary containers */
  --bg-board: #e2e8f0;           /* Slightly grayish game board */
  --bg-board-cell: #cbd5e1;      /* Grid accent / cell texture */
  --border-light: #e2e8f0;       /* Crisp hairline borders */
  --border-strong: #cbd5e1;      /* Emphasized borders */
  
  /* Text & Primary Accents (Dark Slate / Charcoal) */
  --text-primary: #0f172a;       /* Deep slate heading text */
  --text-secondary: #475569;     /* Body & secondary labels */
  --text-muted: #64748b;         /* Captions & helper text */
  --text-inverse: #ffffff;       /* Text on dark buttons */

  /* Snake Skin Accent Variables (Default: Obsidian Slate) */
  --accent-snake-head: #1e293b;
  --accent-snake-body: #334155;
  --accent-snake-tail: #475569;
  --accent-tongue: #dc2626;

  /* Tasteful, Harmonious Accents (NO violet/purple AI colors) */
  --accent-apple: #dc2626;       /* Crisp ruby red apple */
  --accent-apple-leaf: #16a34a;  /* Natural leaf green */
  --accent-star: #d97706;        /* Warm amber golden fruit */
  --accent-berry: #0284c7;       /* Ice blue freeze berry */
  --accent-danger: #ef4444;      /* Danger alerts */
  --accent-success: #10b981;     /* Success badges */

  /* Achievement Tier Colors */
  --tier-bronze-bg: #fffbeb;
  --tier-bronze-border: #fde68a;
  --tier-bronze-text: #b45309;
  
  --tier-silver-bg: #f8fafc;
  --tier-silver-border: #cbd5e1;
  --tier-silver-text: #475569;

  --tier-gold-bg: #fefce8;
  --tier-gold-border: #fef08a;
  --tier-gold-text: #a16207;

  /* Typography */
  --font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;

  /* Shadows (Minimal, crisp, zero neon/glow) */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
  --shadow-card: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);

  /* Border Radii */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 10px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;
  --radius-xl: 18px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  /* Transitions */
  --transition-fast: 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --transition-normal: 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

  /* Board Grid Size Variable */
  --grid-size: 20;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Snake Skin Themes (Selected in Settings)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
[data-snake-skin="emerald"] {
  --accent-snake-head: #065f46;
  --accent-snake-body: #047857;
  --accent-snake-tail: #059669;
}
[data-snake-skin="cobalt"] {
  --accent-snake-head: #1e3a8a;
  --accent-snake-body: #1d4ed8;
  --accent-snake-tail: #2563eb;
}
[data-snake-skin="amber"] {
  --accent-snake-head: #92400e;
  --accent-snake-body: #b45309;
  --accent-snake-tail: #d97706;
}
[data-snake-skin="crimson"] {
  --accent-snake-head: #881337;
  --accent-snake-body: #9f1239;
  --accent-snake-tail: #be123c;
}
[data-snake-skin="sage"] {
  --accent-snake-head: #365314;
  --accent-snake-body: #4d7c0f;
  --accent-snake-tail: #65a30d;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. Reset & Base Typography
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  color-scheme: light;
  height: 100%;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-family);
  background-color: var(--bg-page);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. Mobile Landscape Blocker
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.orientation-blocker {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 999999;
  background-color: var(--bg-page);
  padding: 2rem;
  text-align: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.orientation-blocker-content {
  max-width: 380px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.orientation-icon {
  font-size: 3rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  animation: rotatePhone 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
}

.orientation-blocker h2 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.orientation-blocker p {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

@keyframes rotatePhone {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) and (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape),
       (max-width: 767px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .orientation-blocker {
    display: flex !important;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   4. App Shell & Header (Precision Logo Alignment)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
}

.app-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.65rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  user-select: none;
}

.brand-title {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1;
}

.brand-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background-color: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  line-height: 1;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.btn-icon {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.btn-icon:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-icon:active { transform: translateY(0); }

.icon-sub-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  right: -4px;
  background: var(--accent-star);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* Color Helper Utilities */
.text-amber { color: var(--accent-star) !important; }
.text-crimson { color: var(--accent-apple) !important; }
.text-emerald { color: var(--accent-apple-leaf) !important; }
.text-danger { color: var(--accent-danger) !important; }
.text-muted { color: var(--text-muted) !important; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   5. Main Layout & Quick Stats
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.game-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.board-column {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 560px;
  width: 100%;
}

.sidebar-column {
  width: 320px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Mobile Quick Stats */
.mobile-stats-bar {
  display: none;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 440px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.mini-stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.mini-label {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.mini-value {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.mini-value.badge-speed {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  padding: 0.12rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-top: 1px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   6. Game Board Frame & Styling
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.board-frame {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  max-width: 530px;
  max-height: 530px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-board);
  padding: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
  user-select: none;
  touch-action: none;
  transition: opacity 180ms ease, visibility 180ms ease;
}

body.modal-open .board-frame {
  filter: blur(1.5px);
  transition: filter var(--transition-fast);
}

.game-board {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: var(--bg-board);
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-xl) - 4px);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-image: 
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: calc(100% / var(--grid-size)) calc(100% / var(--grid-size));
}

.buff-banner {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 30;
  animation: slideDown 180ms ease;
}

@keyframes slideDown {
  from { transform: translate(-50%, -10px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translate(-50%, 0); opacity: 1; }
}

.countdown-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 50;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-xl) - 4px);
}

.countdown-number {
  font-size: 5.5rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1;
}

.countdown-number.anim-pop {
  animation: countdownPop 0.72s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.countdown-label {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

@keyframes countdownPop {
  0% { transform: scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
  35% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 1; }
  65% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0.85; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   6b. In-Board Pause Overlay (Borderless, Soft Optical Blur, Authentic Feel)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.pause-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 45;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-xl) - 4px);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  animation: pauseFadeIn 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

@keyframes pauseFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.98); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

.inboard-pause-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.inboard-pause-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  animation: pulsePauseIcon 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulsePauseIcon {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.95; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 0.55; }
}

.inboard-pause-title {
  font-size: 2.25rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.inboard-pause-hint {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.inboard-pause-hint kbd {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 0.18rem 0.48rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Desktop Shortcuts Reference Bar */
.board-shortcuts-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
}

.shortcut-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.shortcut-tag kbd,
.kbd-sidebar-pill {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 0.12rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  line-height: 1;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   7. Snake & Entities Styling (Persistent & Animated Tongue)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.snake-segment {
  position: absolute;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background-color: var(--accent-snake-body);
  border-radius: 4px;
  z-index: 10;
  transition: transform 50ms linear;
}

.snake-head {
  background-color: var(--accent-snake-head);
  z-index: 15;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: visible !important;
}

.snake-head.dir-right { border-radius: 4px 10px 10px 4px; }
.snake-head.dir-left  { border-radius: 10px 4px 4px 10px; }
.snake-head.dir-up    { border-radius: 10px 10px 4px 4px; }
.snake-head.dir-down  { border-radius: 4px 4px 10px 10px; }

.snake-eyes {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.snake-eye {
  position: absolute;
  width: 26%;
  height: 26%;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.snake-eye::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: 55%;
  height: 55%;
  background: #0f172a;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.dir-right .snake-eye-1 { top: 16%; right: 24%; }
.dir-right .snake-eye-2 { bottom: 16%; right: 24%; }
.dir-right .snake-eye::after { right: 8%; top: 22%; }

.dir-left .snake-eye-1 { top: 16%; left: 24%; }
.dir-left .snake-eye-2 { bottom: 16%; left: 24%; }
.dir-left .snake-eye::after { left: 8%; top: 22%; }

.dir-up .snake-eye-1 { top: 24%; left: 16%; }
.dir-up .snake-eye-2 { top: 24%; right: 16%; }
.dir-up .snake-eye::after { top: 8%; left: 22%; }

.dir-down .snake-eye-1 { bottom: 24%; left: 16%; }
.dir-down .snake-eye-2 { bottom: 24%; right: 16%; }
.dir-down .snake-eye::after { bottom: 8%; left: 22%; }

/* Snake Tongue */
.snake-tongue {
  position: absolute;
  background-color: var(--accent-tongue);
  z-index: 25;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dir-right .snake-tongue {
  left: 100%;
  top: 50%;
  margin-top: -1.5px;
  width: 58%;
  height: 3px;
  transform-origin: left center;
  animation: tongueFlickRight 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.dir-right .snake-tongue::before,
.dir-right .snake-tongue::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  right: -4px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 2px;
  background-color: var(--accent-tongue);
}
.dir-right .snake-tongue::before { top: -2px; transform: rotate(32deg); }
.dir-right .snake-tongue::after { bottom: -2px; transform: rotate(-32deg); }

.dir-left .snake-tongue {
  right: 100%;
  top: 50%;
  margin-top: -1.5px;
  width: 58%;
  height: 3px;
  transform-origin: right center;
  animation: tongueFlickLeft 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.dir-left .snake-tongue::before,
.dir-left .snake-tongue::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -4px;
  width: 5px;
  height: 2px;
  background-color: var(--accent-tongue);
}
.dir-left .snake-tongue::before { top: -2px; transform: rotate(-32deg); }
.dir-left .snake-tongue::after { bottom: -2px; transform: rotate(32deg); }

.dir-up .snake-tongue {
  bottom: 100%;
  left: 50%;
  margin-left: -1.5px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 58%;
  transform-origin: center bottom;
  animation: tongueFlickUp 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.dir-up .snake-tongue::before,
.dir-up .snake-tongue::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 5px;
  background-color: var(--accent-tongue);
}
.dir-up .snake-tongue::before { left: -2px; transform: rotate(-32deg); }
.dir-up .snake-tongue::after { right: -2px; transform: rotate(32deg); }

.dir-down .snake-tongue {
  top: 100%;
  left: 50%;
  margin-left: -1.5px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 58%;
  transform-origin: center top;
  animation: tongueFlickDown 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.dir-down .snake-tongue::before,
.dir-down .snake-tongue::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -4px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 5px;
  background-color: var(--accent-tongue);
}
.dir-down .snake-tongue::before { left: -2px; transform: rotate(32deg); }
.dir-down .snake-tongue::after { right: -2px; transform: rotate(-32deg); }

@keyframes tongueFlickRight {
  0%, 20% { transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; }
  28% { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; }
  34% { transform: scaleX(0.75) rotate(5deg); opacity: 1; }
  40% { transform: scaleX(1.15) rotate(-5deg); opacity: 1; }
  46% { transform: scaleX(0.85) rotate(4deg); opacity: 1; }
  54% { transform: scaleX(1.05) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
  62% { transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes tongueFlickLeft {
  0%, 20% { transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; }
  28% { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; }
  34% { transform: scaleX(0.75) rotate(-5deg); opacity: 1; }
  40% { transform: scaleX(1.15) rotate(5deg); opacity: 1; }
  46% { transform: scaleX(0.85) rotate(-4deg); opacity: 1; }
  54% { transform: scaleX(1.05) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
  62% { transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes tongueFlickUp {
  0%, 20% { transform: scaleY(0); opacity: 0; }
  28% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; }
  34% { transform: scaleY(0.75) rotate(5deg); opacity: 1; }
  40% { transform: scaleY(1.15) rotate(-5deg); opacity: 1; }
  46% { transform: scaleY(0.85) rotate(4deg); opacity: 1; }
  54% { transform: scaleY(1.05) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
  62% { transform: scaleY(0); opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: scaleY(0); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes tongueFlickDown {
  0%, 20% { transform: scaleY(0); opacity: 0; }
  28% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; }
  34% { transform: scaleY(0.75) rotate(-5deg); opacity: 1; }
  40% { transform: scaleY(1.15) rotate(5deg); opacity: 1; }
  46% { transform: scaleY(0.85) rotate(-4deg); opacity: 1; }
  54% { transform: scaleY(1.05) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
  62% { transform: scaleY(0); opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: scaleY(0); opacity: 0; }
}

.snake-tail {
  background-color: var(--accent-snake-tail);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: scale(0.85);
}

/* Food Items */
.food-item {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 12;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: transform 120ms ease;
}

.food-apple {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #ef4444, #dc2626 70%, #991b1b);
  border-radius: 50% 50% 45% 45%;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);
}

.food-apple::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -18%;
  right: 25%;
  width: 32%;
  height: 38%;
  background: var(--accent-apple-leaf);
  border-radius: 0 85% 0 85%;
  transform: rotate(25deg);
}

.food-apple::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -12%;
  left: 45%;
  width: 12%;
  height: 22%;
  background: #78350f;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transform: rotate(-10deg);
}

.food-star {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fbbf24, #d97706 70%, #b45309);
  border-radius: 35%;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);
  animation: starBob 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;
}

.food-star::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 2px;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  border-radius: 30%;
}

@keyframes starBob {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.12); }
}

.food-berry {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #38bdf8, #0284c7 70%, #0369a1);
  border-radius: 45%;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);
  animation: berryPulse 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes berryPulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(0.92); }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   8. Floating Score Badges (High Contrast & Clamped)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.floating-score {
  position: absolute;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 45;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: #ffffff;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
  animation: floatUpFade 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.floating-score.bonus-pill {
  background: #fffbeb;
  color: #92400e;
  border-color: #f59e0b;
}

.floating-score.chill-pill {
  background: #f0f9ff;
  color: #0369a1;
  border-color: #38bdf8;
}

@keyframes floatUpFade {
  0%   { transform: translate(-50%, -20%) scale(0.85); opacity: 0; }
  22%  { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.06); opacity: 1; }
  70%  { transform: translate(-50%, -90%) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translate(-50%, -130%) scale(0.92); opacity: 0; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   9. Touch Controls
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.touch-controls {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 320px;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  touch-action: none;
}

.dpad-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  width: 210px;
  height: 210px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dpad-btn {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), transform 70ms ease;
}

.dpad-btn:active {
  background-color: var(--bg-board);
  transform: scale(0.92);
}

.dpad-center {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.cell-empty { pointer-events: none; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   10. Sidebar Cards & Quick Actions
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.card {

}

.card-title {

}

.stat-badge {

  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);

}

.speed-pill {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem;
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.score-display {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

.score-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.score-label { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); }
.score-number {
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.score-divider {

}

/* Combo Meter */
.combo-wrapper {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;

}

.combo-header {

}

.combo-badge {

}

.combo-meter {

  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.combo-fill {
  height: 100%;

  border-radius: var(--radius-full);

}

.combo-fill.combo-x2 { background: #d97706; }
.combo-fill.combo-x3 { background: #059669; }
.combo-fill.combo-x4 { background: #0284c7; }
.combo-fill.combo-x5 { background: #dc2626; }

/* Metrics Grid */
.metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0.65rem;
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
}

.metric-item {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem;

  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.metric-icon { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.metric-details { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.metric-val {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.metric-name { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); }

/* Quick Actions Card (Achievements & Help in Sidebar) */
.quick-actions-card {
  padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem;
}

.quick-action-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);

  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.quick-action-row:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
}

.quick-action-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.quick-action-title {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.quick-action-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.quick-action-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border-light);
  margin: 0 0.5rem;
}

.action-arrow {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

/* Legend */
.legend-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
}

.legend-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.legend-keys { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: center; }

kbd {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.35rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.legend-action { color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 500; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   11. App Footer
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-footer {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 0.55rem 0;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.app-footer p {
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.app-footer a {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.app-footer a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  color: #000000;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   12. Dedicated Modal Layer & Backdrop Canvas
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.modal-overlay.active { display: flex; }

.modal-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

/* Ambient Canvas (Subtle Autonomous Slithering Snake) */
.ambient-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1004;
  opacity: 0.07; /* Very faint, atmospheric, zero distraction */
}

.modal-window {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1010;
  display: none;
  width: 100%;
}

.modal-window.active {
  display: block;
  animation: modalEnter 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

@keyframes modalEnter {
  from { transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.98); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}

.modal-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  max-height: min(88vh, 88dvh);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.modal-scrollable {
  /* Class retained for semantic compatibility; inner modal-body handles scrolling */
  overflow: hidden;
}

.modal-header {
  padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem 0.85rem 1.4rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.modal-header.text-center {
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
}

.modal-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.modal-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

.modal-body {
  padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-medium) transparent;
}

.modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 5px;
}

.modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.modal-footer {
  padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem 1.25rem 1.4rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.modal-footer.flex-column { flex-direction: column; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   14. Ultra-Premium Redesigned Settings Modal
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.modal-window-settings {
  max-width: 500px;
}

/* Live Snake Preview Box */
.settings-preview-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.preview-header-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.preview-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.preview-skin-title {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.preview-snake-track {
  height: 52px;
  background: var(--bg-board);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-segment {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.preview-head {
  position: relative;
  background-color: var(--accent-snake-head);
  border-radius: 4px 10px 10px 4px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-normal);
}

.preview-eyes {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}

.preview-eye {
  position: absolute;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.preview-eye::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: 3px;
  height: 3px;
  background: #0f172a;
  border-radius: 50%;
  right: 0.5px;
  top: 1px;
}

.preview-eye-1 { top: 3px; right: 5px; }
.preview-eye-2 { bottom: 3px; right: 5px; }

.preview-tongue {
  position: absolute;
  left: 100%;
  top: 50%;
  margin-top: -1.5px;
  width: 12px;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--accent-tongue);
  transform-origin: left center;
  animation: tongueFlickRight 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.preview-tongue::before,
.preview-tongue::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  right: -3px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent-tongue);
}
.preview-tongue::before { top: -1.5px; transform: rotate(30deg); }
.preview-tongue::after { bottom: -1.5px; transform: rotate(-30deg); }

.preview-body {
  background-color: var(--accent-snake-body);
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-normal);
}

.preview-tail {
  background-color: var(--accent-snake-tail);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: scale(0.85);
  transition: background-color var(--transition-normal);
}

.preview-target-apple {
  position: relative;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #ef4444, #dc2626 70%, #991b1b);
  margin-left: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.28);
  animation: appleSubtleGlow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes appleSubtleGlow {
  0% { transform: scale(1); }
  100% { transform: scale(1.08); }
}

.preview-target-apple .mini-apple-leaf {
  position: absolute;
  top: -2.5px;
  right: 2px;
  width: 6px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--accent-apple-leaf);
  border-radius: 0 80% 0 80%;
  transform: rotate(20deg);
}

/* Settings Group Container */
.settings-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.settings-group-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* Skin Selector Grid Cards */
.skin-selector-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.skin-swatch-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.skin-swatch-card:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.skin-swatch-card.active {
  border-color: var(--text-primary);
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--text-primary), 0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
}

.swatch-disc {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;

}

.swatch-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  flex: 1;
  text-align: left;
}

.swatch-check {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  display: none;
}

.skin-swatch-card.active .swatch-check {

}

/* Grouped Card Stack (iOS / macOS Style Rows) */
.settings-card-stack {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.settings-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.settings-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.settings-row-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.settings-row-icon {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.settings-row-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.settings-row-title {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.settings-row-desc {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Segmented Control Buttons */
.segmented-control {
  display: flex;
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 3px;
  gap: 2px;
}

.segment-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-md) - 2px);

  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-secondary);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;

}

.segment-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
.segment-btn.active {
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
}

/* Danger Section */
.settings-danger-card {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.18);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.danger-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.danger-title {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--accent-danger);
}

.danger-desc {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.btn-danger-subtle {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
  color: var(--accent-danger);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-danger-subtle:hover {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
  border-color: var(--accent-danger);
}

.flex-row-buttons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.flex-1 { flex: 1; }
.flex-2 { flex: 2; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------

   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.modal-window-help {

}

.help-tabs-bar {

}

.help-tab {

.help-content-area {

.help-card-title {

.key-badge-wrap { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: center; }

.help-touch-explainer {

/* Food Explainer List */

}

.food-explainer-item {

.apple-disc {

.food-explainer-info {

}

.food-name-row {

}

.food-name-row strong {
  font-size: 0.82rem;

}

.food-badge-base {
  font-size: 0.65rem;

.food-badge-bonus {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

}

.food-badge-chill {
  font-size: 0.65rem;

.food-explainer-info p {

.help-text-para {

.help-bullet-list {

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------

   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.modal-window-achievements {

}

.header-badge-row {

}

.badge-pill {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.55rem;

}

.achieve-filter-bar {
  display: flex;

  border-radius: var(--radius-md);

}

.filter-tab {
  flex: 1;

  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-md) - 2px);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;

.filter-tab:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
.filter-tab.active {

.achievements-list {

.achievements-empty-state {

}

.empty-state-icon {

.empty-state-title {

  font-weight: 800;

}

.empty-state-desc {

.achievement-card {

.achievement-card.completed {

.achievement-medal {

.achievement-medal.bronze {

.achievement-medal.silver {

}

.achievement-medal.gold {
  background: var(--tier-gold-bg);

}

.achievement-info {
  flex: 1;

}

.achievement-title-row {

.achievement-name {

.achievement-tier-tag {

.achievement-tier-tag.bronze { background: var(--tier-bronze-bg); color: var(--tier-bronze-text); }
.achievement-tier-tag.silver { background: var(--tier-silver-bg); color: var(--tier-silver-text); }

.achievement-desc {

}

.achievement-progress-wrap {

.achievement-progress-bar {

.achievement-progress-fill {

.achievement-progress-text {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;

.achievement-status-badge {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--accent-success);

}

/* Modern Layered Achievement Toast (Upper Center) */
.achievement-toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  top: 20px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 3100;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 400px;
}

.achievement-toast {
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  box-shadow: 
    0 10px 30px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem 0.85rem 0.9rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  pointer-events: auto;
  min-width: 280px;
  max-width: 380px;
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: achToastIn 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), achToastOut 240ms ease 3.5s forwards;
}

.achievement-toast.tier-gold {
  border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45);
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -4px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.18),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

.achievement-toast.tier-silver {
  border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55);
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -4px rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.16),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

.achievement-toast.tier-bronze {
  border-color: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -4px rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.14),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

.achievement-toast-medal {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), 0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
}

.achievement-toast-medal.gold {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef3c7 0%, #fde68a 100%);
  color: #b45309;
  border: 1px solid #f59e0b;
}

.achievement-toast-medal.silver {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #e2e8f0 100%);
  color: #475569;
  border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
}

.achievement-toast-medal.bronze {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffedd5 0%, #fed7aa 100%);
  color: #9a3412;
  border: 1px solid #ea580c;
}

.achievement-toast-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
  flex: 1;
}

.achievement-toast-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.achievement-toast-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.achievement-toast-tier {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  padding: 0.08rem 0.35rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

.achievement-toast.tier-gold .achievement-toast-tier {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  color: #b45309;
}

.achievement-toast.tier-silver .achievement-toast-tier {
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12);
  color: #475569;
}

.achievement-toast.tier-bronze .achievement-toast-tier {
  background: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.12);
  color: #9a3412;
}

.achievement-toast-name {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.achievement-toast-timer {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 2.5px;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  opacity: 0.25;
  animation: achTimerBar 3.5s linear forwards;
}

.achievement-toast.tier-gold .achievement-toast-timer { background: #f59e0b; opacity: 0.6; }
.achievement-toast.tier-silver .achievement-toast-timer { background: #64748b; opacity: 0.5; }
.achievement-toast.tier-bronze .achievement-toast-timer { background: #ea580c; opacity: 0.5; }

@keyframes achToastIn {
  from { transform: translateY(-24px) scale(0.95); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes achToastOut {
  from { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  to { transform: translateY(-18px) scale(0.95); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes achTimerBar {
  from { width: 100%; }
  to { width: 0%; }
}

/* General Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding: 0.68rem 1.15rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.btn-sm { padding: 0.42rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.76rem; }
.btn-block { width: 100%; }

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background: #1e293b;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

.btn-secondary {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-subtle); }

.btn-tertiary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.btn-tertiary:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }

.btn-danger { background: var(--accent-danger); color: #ffffff; }
.btn-danger:hover { background: #dc2626; }

/* Status & Danger Badges */
.badge-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.badge-danger {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
  color: #dc2626;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.pause-stats-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.summary-box {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 0.95rem 0.85rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.summary-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.summary-number {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

/* Results Grid & Hero Score Presentation */
.new-record-banner {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12), rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.15));
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
  color: #b45309;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.gameover-hero-score {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface-subtle) 0%, rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.6) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.15rem 1rem 0.95rem 1rem;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.hero-score-label {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
}

.hero-score-val {
  font-size: 2.85rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.hero-score-unit {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

.gameover-stats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.gameover-stats-grid .result-tile {
  background: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.7rem 0.4rem;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.gameover-stats-grid .tile-icon {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.gameover-stats-grid .tile-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}

.gameover-stats-grid .tile-number {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Button Keyboard Hint Tag */
.btn-kbd {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  color: inherit;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  line-height: 1;
}

.btn-secondary .btn-kbd,
.btn-tertiary .btn-kbd {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-color: var(--border-light);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.notice-box {
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.25);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: #92400e;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

/* Dialog & Toasts */
.confirm-dialog-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2000;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.confirm-dialog-overlay.active { display: flex; animation: modalEnter 180ms ease-out; }

.confirm-dialog-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.4rem;
  max-width: 370px;
  width: 100%;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.confirm-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.confirm-message { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 1.15rem; }
.confirm-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; }

.toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 3000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 420px;
}

.toast {
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  animation: toastIn 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), toastOut 200ms ease 2.8s forwards;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

@keyframes toastIn {
  from { transform: translateY(16px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes toastOut {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   17. Responsive Breakpoints
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  body { overflow: hidden; }

  .app-container {
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .game-layout {
    flex: 1;
    align-items: center;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 110px);
  }

  .board-frame {
    width: min(520px, calc(100vh - 150px));
    height: min(520px, calc(100vh - 150px));
  }

  .sidebar-column {
    max-height: calc(100vh - 120px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  .sidebar-column::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .board-column {
    position: relative;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .board-shortcuts-bar {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 0.45rem);
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    margin-top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .touch-controls { display: none !important; }

  .web-only-shortcuts { display: flex !important; }

}

@media (min-width: 1025px) and (max-height: 780px) {

  .app-header { padding: 0.45rem 0; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }

    width: min(440px, calc(100vh - 130px));
    height: min(440px, calc(100vh - 130px));

  .board-shortcuts-bar {

  .sidebar-column { width: 290px; gap: 0.5rem; }

/* Strict Non-Web Mode: All Tablets and Mobile Devices (<= 1024px) */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {

  .btn-kbd,
  .web-only-hint,
  .kbd-sidebar-pill {

  }
  .touch-only-hint {
    display: flex !important;
  }
}

/* Tablet (768px to 1024px) */
@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  body {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .app-container {
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    max-height: 100dvh;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0 1rem;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  /* Tablet Landscape (iPad landscape, 1024x768, etc.) */
  @media (orientation: landscape) {
    .app-header {
      padding: 0.45rem 0;
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    }

    .game-layout {
      flex-direction: row;
      gap: 1.25rem;

      justify-content: center;

      min-height: 0;

      display: flex;

      justify-content: center;
    }

    .touch-controls {
      display: flex;

      margin: 0;
      order: -1; /* D-pad on the left for left thumb, board in center */

    .dpad-grid {
      width: 154px;
      height: 154px;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .board-frame {
      width: min(390px, calc(100dvh - 110px), 42vw);
      height: min(390px, calc(100dvh - 110px), 42vw);
    }

      gap: 0.5rem;

      overflow-y: auto;

    }

    .legend-card {
      display: none;
    }

    .mobile-stats-bar {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .app-footer {
      padding: 0.45rem 0;

    .game-layout {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      min-height: 0;

      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      width: 100%;

    .dpad-grid {
      width: 165px;

      display: none !important;
    }

    .app-footer {

      font-size: 0.75rem;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
  }

  const ModalManager = {
    overlay: document.getElementById('modal-overlay'),
    startModal: document.getElementById('modal-start'),
    gameoverModal: document.getElementById('modal-gameover'),
    settingsModal: document.getElementById('modal-settings'),
    achievementsModal: document.getElementById('modal-achievements'),
    helpModal: document.getElementById('modal-help'),
    confirmOverlay: document.getElementById('confirm-dialog'),
    activeModal: null,
    returnModal: null,

    open(modalElement) {
      if (!modalElement) return;

      // Auto-pause active game session whenever ANY modal opens
      if (window.snakeGame && 
          (window.snakeGame.state === STATES.PLAYING || window.snakeGame.state === STATES.COUNTDOWN) &&
          modalElement !== this.gameoverModal) {
        window.snakeGame.pauseGame('Game paused automatically.');
      }

      // Track return target if navigating away from Start or GameOver to secondary modals
      if (this.activeModal === this.startModal || this.activeModal === this.gameoverModal) {
        if (modalElement === this.settingsModal || modalElement === this.helpModal || modalElement === this.achievementsModal) {
          this.returnModal = this.activeModal;
        }
      }

      // Toggle ambient snake canvas on start screen
      if (window.snakeGame && window.snakeGame.ambientSnake) {
        if (modalElement === this.startModal) {
          window.snakeGame.ambientSnake.start();
        } else {
          window.snakeGame.ambientSnake.stop();
        }
      }

      this.closeAllWindows();

      document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
      this.overlay.classList.add('active');
      modalElement.classList.add('active');
      this.activeModal = modalElement;
      this.overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    },

    closeAllWindows() {
      const windows = [
        this.startModal,
        this.gameoverModal,
        this.settingsModal,
        this.achievementsModal,
        this.helpModal
      ];
      windows.forEach(w => {
        if (w) w.classList.remove('active');
      });
      this.activeModal = null;
    },

    closeAll() {
      this.closeAllWindows();
      document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
      this.overlay.classList.remove('active');
      this.overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      this.returnModal = null;
      if (window.snakeGame && window.snakeGame.ambientSnake) {
        window.snakeGame.ambientSnake.stop();
      }
    },

    dismiss() {
      if (!this.activeModal) return;

      const pendingReturn = this.returnModal;
      this.closeAll();

      if (pendingReturn) {
        this.open(pendingReturn);
        return;
      }

      if (window.snakeGame) {
        if (window.snakeGame.state === STATES.MENU) {
          this.open(this.startModal);
        } else if (window.snakeGame.state === STATES.GAMEOVER) {
          this.open(this.gameoverModal);
        } else if (window.snakeGame.state === STATES.PAUSED) {
          if (window.snakeGame.dom.pauseOverlay) {
            window.snakeGame.dom.pauseOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
          }
        }
      }
    },

    closeDismissableModal() {
      if (!this.activeModal) return;
      if (this.activeModal === this.startModal || this.activeModal === this.gameoverModal) {
        return;
      }

      const current = this.activeModal;
      if (current === this.settingsModal && window.snakeGame) {
        window.snakeGame.cancelSettings();
        return;
      }

      this.dismiss();
    },

    confirm(title, message, onConfirm) {
      if (window.snakeGame && 
          (window.snakeGame.state === STATES.PLAYING || window.snakeGame.state === STATES.COUNTDOWN)) {
        window.snakeGame.pauseGame('Game paused automatically.');
      }

      const titleEl = document.getElementById('confirm-title');
      const msgEl = document.getElementById('confirm-message');
      const btnOk = document.getElementById('confirm-btn-ok');
      const btnCancel = document.getElementById('confirm-btn-cancel');

      if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = title;
      if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = message;

      this.confirmOverlay.classList.add('active');
      this.confirmOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

      const cleanup = () => {
        this.confirmOverlay.classList.remove('active');
        this.confirmOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        btnOk.onclick = null;
        btnCancel.onclick = null;
      };

      btnOk.onclick = () => {
        cleanup();
        if (typeof onConfirm === 'function') onConfirm();
      };

      btnCancel.onclick = () => {
        cleanup();
      };
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // 3.5. Ear-Friendly Web Audio Sound Effects Engine (Smooth & Harmonic)
  // =========================================================================
  const SoundFX = {
    ctx: null,
    masterGain: null,
    filterNode: null,
    enabled: true,

    init() {
      if (this.ctx) return;
      try {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioCtx) return;
        this.ctx = new AudioCtx();

        // Master lowpass filter strips harsh, piercing frequencies ("kulak acıtmamalı")
        this.filterNode = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
        this.filterNode.type = 'lowpass';
        this.filterNode.frequency.setValueAtTime(3200, this.ctx.currentTime);
        this.filterNode.Q.setValueAtTime(0.7, this.ctx.currentTime);

        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.enabled ? 0.22 : 0, this.ctx.currentTime);

        this.filterNode.connect(this.masterGain);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Web Audio initialization error:', e);
      }
    },

    ensureContext() {
      if (!this.ctx) this.init();
      if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
        this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
      }
      return this.ctx && this.enabled;
    },

    setEnabled(val) {
      this.enabled = !!val;
      if (this.masterGain && this.ctx) {
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.masterGain.gain.value, now);
        this.masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(this.enabled ? 0.22 : 0, now + 0.05);
      }
    },

    // 1. Classic Apple Pop (Crisp, gentle, satisfying bubble bite)
    eatApple() {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(540, now);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(380, now + 0.07);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.24, now + 0.006);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.08);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.filterNode);

      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.085);
    },

    // 2. Combo Streak Pitch Ping (Ascending harmonic pentatonic scale)
    combo(streak) {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

      const scale = [523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 783.99, 880.00, 1046.50];
      const freq = scale[Math.min(streak - 1, scale.length - 1)] || 523.25;

      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18, now + 0.008);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.16);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.filterNode);

      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.17);
    },

    // 3. Special Foods (Golden Star & Chill Berry)
    eatSpecial(type) {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

      if (type === 'star') {
        const notes = [1046.5, 1318.5, 1567.98, 2093.0];
        notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
          const noteStart = now + idx * 0.045;
          const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

          osc.type = 'sine';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, noteStart);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, noteStart);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.2, noteStart + 0.008);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, noteStart + 0.22);

          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(this.filterNode);

          osc.start(noteStart);
          osc.stop(noteStart + 0.23);
        });
      } else if (type === 'berry') {
        const freqs = [659.25, 987.77];
        freqs.forEach((freq) => {
          const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

          osc.type = 'sine';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.95, now + 0.35);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.15, now + 0.02);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.4);

          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(this.filterNode);

          osc.start(now);
          osc.stop(now + 0.42);
        });
      }
    },

    // 4. Countdown Ticks (3, 2, 1, GO!)
    countdown(count) {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

      if (count > 0) {
        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(320, now + 0.09);

        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18, now + 0.008);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.12);

        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.filterNode);

        osc.start(now);
        osc.stop(now + 0.13);
      } else {
        const chord = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99];
        chord.forEach((freq) => {
          const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

          osc.type = 'sine';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, now + 0.012);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.32);

          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(this.filterNode);

          osc.start(now);
          osc.stop(now + 0.34);
        });
      }
    },

    // 5. Game Over / Collision (Soft bass thud, zero screeching)
    gameOver() {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

      const osc1 = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain1 = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc1.type = 'triangle';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, now);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(55, now + 0.18);

      gain1.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gain1.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.22, now + 0.01);
      gain1.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.22);

      osc1.connect(gain1);
      gain1.connect(this.filterNode);
      osc1.start(now);
      osc1.stop(now + 0.23);

      const osc2 = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain2 = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(261.63, now + 0.06);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(207.65, now + 0.38);

      gain2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
      gain2.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.15, now + 0.08);
      gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.42);

      osc2.connect(gain2);
      gain2.connect(this.filterNode);
      osc2.start(now + 0.06);
      osc2.stop(now + 0.44);
    },

    // 6. Achievement Unlocked (Warm, triumphant royal chime)
    achievement() {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

      const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5];
      notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
        const noteStart = now + idx * 0.065;
        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, noteStart);

        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, noteStart);
        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.2, noteStart + 0.01);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, noteStart + 0.45);

        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.filterNode);

        osc.start(noteStart);
        osc.stop(noteStart + 0.48);
      });
    },

    // 7. Pause & Resume Cues
    pause() {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(520, now);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(392, now + 0.05);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, now + 0.008);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.11);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.filterNode);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.12);
    },

    resume() {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(392, now);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(520, now + 0.05);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, now + 0.008);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.11);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.filterNode);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.12);
    },

    // 8. Subtle UI Tactile Micro-Click
    click() {
      if (!this.ensureContext()) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, now);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(440, now + 0.025);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.06, now + 0.003);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.03);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.filterNode);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.035);
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. Ambient Wandering Snake Background (Start Screen Only)
  // =========================================================================
  class AmbientSnakeBackground {
    constructor(canvasId) {
      this.canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
      if (!this.canvas) return;
      this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
      this.animId = null;
      this.isRunning = false;

      this.numSegments = 28;
      this.segDist = 14;
      this.segments = [];
      this.angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      this.targetAngle = this.angle;
      this.speed = 1.6;
      this.turnSpeed = 0.04;
      this.width = window.innerWidth;
      this.height = window.innerHeight;
      this.head = { x: this.width * 0.5, y: this.height * 0.5 };

      for (let i = 0; i < this.numSegments; i++) {
        this.segments.push({
          x: this.head.x - i * this.segDist,
          y: this.head.y
        });
      }

      this.onResize = () => this.resize();
      window.addEventListener('resize', this.onResize);
      this.resize();
    }

    resize() {
      if (!this.canvas) return;
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      this.width = window.innerWidth;
      this.height = window.innerHeight;
      this.canvas.width = this.width * dpr;
      this.canvas.height = this.height * dpr;
      if (this.ctx) {
        this.ctx.resetTransform();
        this.ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
      }
    }

    start() {
      if (this.isRunning || !this.canvas) return;
      this.isRunning = true;
      this.resize();
      let lastTime = performance.now();

      const loop = (time) => {
        if (!this.isRunning) return;
        const dt = Math.min((time - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
        lastTime = time;
        this.update(dt);
        this.draw();
        this.animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      };

      this.animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    stop() {
      this.isRunning = false;
      if (this.animId) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(this.animId);
        this.animId = null;
      }
      if (this.ctx && this.canvas) {
        this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
      }
    }

    update(dt) {
      if (Math.random() < 0.04) {
        this.targetAngle += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
      }

      const margin = 110;
      if (this.head.x < margin) this.targetAngle = 0;
      else if (this.head.x > this.width - margin) this.targetAngle = Math.PI;
      if (this.head.y < margin) this.targetAngle = Math.PI / 2;
      else if (this.head.y > this.height - margin) this.targetAngle = -Math.PI / 2;

      let diff = this.targetAngle - this.angle;
      while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2;
      while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2;
      this.angle += diff * Math.min(1, this.turnSpeed * (dt * 60));

      const step = this.speed * (dt * 60);
      this.head.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * step;
      this.head.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * step;

      if (this.head.x < -60) this.head.x = this.width + 60;
      else if (this.head.x > this.width + 60) this.head.x = -60;
      if (this.head.y < -60) this.head.y = this.height + 60;
      else if (this.head.y > this.height + 60) this.head.y = -60;

      this.segments[0].x = this.head.x;
      this.segments[0].y = this.head.y;

      for (let i = 1; i < this.numSegments; i++) {
        const prev = this.segments[i - 1];
        const cur = this.segments[i];
        const dx = cur.x - prev.x;
        const dy = cur.y - prev.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 0.001;
        cur.x = prev.x + (dx / dist) * this.segDist;
        cur.y = prev.y + (dy / dist) * this.segDist;
      }
    }

    draw() {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      if (!ctx) return;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
      if (this.segments.length < 2) return;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      for (let i = this.numSegments - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const p1 = this.segments[i];
        const p0 = this.segments[i - 1];
        const t = i / this.numSegments;
        const width = (1 - t * 0.65) * 22;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(p0.x, p0.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
        ctx.lineWidth = width;
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const head = this.segments[0];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
      ctx.fill();

      const eyeDist = 6;
      const eyeAngle1 = this.angle + Math.PI / 3;
      const eyeAngle2 = this.angle - Math.PI / 3;
      const eyeRadius = 2.5;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(head.x + Math.cos(eyeAngle1) * eyeDist, head.y + Math.sin(eyeAngle1) * eyeDist, eyeRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(head.x + Math.cos(eyeAngle2) * eyeDist, head.y + Math.sin(eyeAngle2) * eyeDist, eyeRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      const timeNow = performance.now();
      const isFlicking = (timeNow % 2600) < 650;
      if (isFlicking) {
        const tongueLen = 14;
        const tx = head.x + Math.cos(this.angle) * (11 + tongueLen);
        const ty = head.y + Math.sin(this.angle) * (11 + tongueLen);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(head.x + Math.cos(this.angle) * 11, head.y + Math.sin(this.angle) * 11);
        ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);
        const forkAngle = 0.4;
        const forkLen = 4;
        ctx.lineTo(tx + Math.cos(this.angle + forkAngle) * forkLen, ty + Math.sin(this.angle + forkAngle) * forkLen);
        ctx.moveTo(tx, ty);
        ctx.lineTo(tx + Math.cos(this.angle - forkAngle) * forkLen, ty + Math.sin(this.angle - forkAngle) * forkLen);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#dc2626';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

      tailEl.className = 'snake-segment snake-tail';
